Art_Unauthorized_Access.title: Unauthorized Access
Art_Unauthorized_Access.rule_text: The unauthorized access article covers intrusion into a protected system and carries a fine or short detention.

Art_Data_Theft.title: Data Theft
Art_Data_Theft.rule_text: The data theft article covers protected-system intrusion combined with data copying and carries imprisonment of not more than 3 years.

Art_System_Disruption.title: System Disruption
Art_System_Disruption.rule_text: The system disruption article covers protected-system intrusion combined with disruptive operation and carries imprisonment of between 3 and 7 years.

Art_Financial_Cyber_Fraud.title: Financial Cyber Fraud
Art_Financial_Cyber_Fraud.rule_text: The financial cyber fraud article covers protected-system intrusion, deceptive payment conduct, and a completed payment loss; it carries imprisonment of between 7 and 15 years.

Art_Security_Testing_Authorization.title: Security Testing Authorization
Art_Security_Testing_Authorization.rule_text: The security testing authorization article covers protected-system intrusion conducted within documented testing safeguards and carries no criminal liability.

Art_Incident_Response_Authorization.title: Incident Response Authorization
Art_Incident_Response_Authorization.rule_text: The incident response authorization article covers protected-system intrusion conducted under documented incident-response safeguards and carries no criminal liability.

uses_stolen_password.positive_text: {name} used a stolen password to enter the system.

target_system_requires_authorization.negative_text: The target system did not require authorization.

owner_permission_for_access.negative_text: The system owner did not permit {name}'s access.

stays_within_test_scope.positive_text: {name} stayed within the agreed testing scope.
stays_within_test_scope.negative_text: {name} did not stay within the agreed testing scope.

reports_findings_promptly.negative_text: {name} did not promptly report the findings.

limits_actions_to_containment.negative_text: {name} did not limit the actions to containment.

rules.name: access_methods_imply_access_method
rules.natural_text: Use of a prohibited access method is present if any one of the following occurs: a person uses a stolen password, bypasses a login control, or exploits an unpatched service.

rules.name: authorization_facts_imply_protected_system
rules.natural_text: Protected-system status is present when the system requires authorization and the owner has not permitted the access.

rules.name: copy_facts_imply_data_copy_action
rules.natural_text: Data-copying conduct is present if any one of the following occurs: the person downloads customer records, copies authentication tokens, or exports a database snapshot.

rules.name: disruption_facts_imply_disruptive_action
rules.natural_text: Service-disruption conduct is present if any one of the following occurs: the person deletes server files, disables monitoring services, or floods a service with requests.

rules.name: payment_facts_imply_deceptive_payment_step
rules.natural_text: Deceptive payment conduct is present when the person either sends a false payment request or redirects an invoice account.

rules.name: obtained_payment_implies_payment_obtained
rules.natural_text: Payment loss is present when a victim payment is actually obtained.

rules.name: testing_facts_imply_security_testing_safeguards
rules.natural_text: Security-testing authorization safeguards are satisfied by a written testing contract, conduct within scope, and prompt reporting.

rules.name: response_facts_imply_incident_response_safeguards
rules.natural_text: Incident-response authorization safeguards are satisfied by a written response order, containment-limited conduct, and preserved logs.

rules.name: access_and_protection_imply_intrusion_basis
rules.natural_text: Unauthorized protected-system intrusion is established when prohibited access is made against a protected system.

rules.name: intrusion_and_copy_imply_data_acquisition_basis
rules.natural_text: Unauthorized data acquisition is established when protected-system intrusion is combined with data-copying conduct.

rules.name: intrusion_and_disruption_imply_service_interference_basis
rules.natural_text: Unauthorized service interference is established when protected-system intrusion is combined with service-disruption conduct.

rules.name: intrusion_payment_step_and_loss_imply_payment_fraud_basis
rules.natural_text: Completed payment fraud is established when protected-system intrusion, deceptive payment conduct, and payment loss are all present.

rules.name: testing_safeguards_imply_testing_authorization
rules.natural_text: Security-testing authorization is established when the required security-testing safeguards are satisfied.

rules.name: response_safeguards_imply_response_authorization
rules.natural_text: Incident-response authorization is established when the required response safeguards are satisfied.
